marble-texture.png.title: Seamless Marble
marble-texture.png.about: Tileable Calacatta-style marble: domain-warped Perlin fBm folded through a sharp sine to make grey veins with fine gold threads. Pure numpy, no image inputs.
marble-texture.png.prompt: Write a Python script with numpy and Pillow that generates a seamless 1024px marble texture: tileable Perlin fBm, domain warping, sharp sine veins in grey plus thin gold veins on a warm white base.

voronoi-cells.png.title: Stained-Glass Voronoi
voronoi-cells.png.about: 72-cell tileable Voronoi diagram computed brute force with F1/F2 distances: each cell glows from its centre and dark leading appears where F2 minus F1 is small, like stained glass.
voronoi-cells.png.prompt: Using numpy and Pillow, render a tileable stained-glass Voronoi texture: random points wrapped across tile edges, F1 and F2 distance fields, jewel-tone cells brightened toward their centres and dark leading lines where F2-F1 is small.

spaceship-sprite-sheet.png.title: Pixel Spaceship Sprites
spaceship-sprite-sheet.png.about: 40 procedural pixel spaceships from a mirrored 12x12 mask (Bollinger style): random body cells, automatic outlines, row-shaded hulls and contrasting cockpits, packed into a game-ready sprite sheet.
spaceship-sprite-sheet.png.prompt: Generate a sprite sheet of 40 unique pixel-art spaceships in Python: use a half mask with always-empty, maybe-body and maybe-cockpit cells, mirror it, outline the body automatically, shade by row with a random hue, and lay them out on an 8x5 grid over a starfield.

terrain-heightmap.png.title: Island Heightmap (16-bit)
terrain-heightmap.png.about: 16-bit greyscale heightmap of a procedural island: rolling plus ridged Perlin fBm with a radial falloff. Drop it into Blender displace, Unity or Unreal terrain.
terrain-heightmap.png.prompt: With numpy, build a 1024px island heightmap from rolling fBm plus squared ridged noise and a radial falloff, normalise it and save a 16-bit greyscale PNG.

terrain-relief.png.title: Shaded Relief Map
terrain-relief.png.about: The same island rendered as a cartographic relief map: hypsometric colour ramp from deep sea to snow, north-west hillshade from the height gradient, and contour lines on land.
terrain-relief.png.prompt: Turn a heightmap into a shaded relief map in Python: hypsometric colour ramp (deep water, shallows, sand, grass, forest, rock, snow), a hillshade from slope and aspect lit from the north-west, and subtle contour lines.

demo-reel.gif.title: Demo Reel GIF
demo-reel.gif.about: The demo reel at 3x speed as a palette-optimised GIF (palettegen + paletteuse) for READMEs and chat embeds.
demo-reel.gif.prompt: Convert the demo reel MP4 into a small looping GIF with ffmpeg: speed it up 3x, 10 fps, 480 px wide, generated palette with Bayer dithering.
